items.title: Add support for customizing Astral mirror URLs
items.reason: Canonical discussion. Its May 18–19 follow-up comments identify the same missing UV_ASTRAL_MIRROR_URL branch in the 0.11.14 standalone installer and request installing the latest version through a releases.astral.sh mirror without hard-coding a version. The new report adds PowerShell evidence and organizational constraints to that unresolved request.

items.title: Add Astral mirror URL override
items.reason: Merged May 12, 2026, closing astral-sh/uv#18525 and introducing the variable in uv 0.11.14. It implemented Rust-side mirror handling, including passing a version-specific UV_DOWNLOAD_URL to the installer during self-update. It did not add direct environment-variable handling to the standalone installer templates, so it does not establish a previously fixed installer regression.

items.title: uv self update does not use astral mirror value when logging
items.reason: Adjacent report from the same author explicitly confirms that self-update downloads use the configured mirror through UV_DOWNLOAD_URL. Its defect concerns the GitHub URL printed after success; this issue concerns actual artifact URL selection when running the standalone scripts directly.

related.search_scope: Searched astral-sh/uv open/closed issues and open/closed/merged PRs with authenticated gh: UV_ASTRAL_MIRROR_URL, UV_DOWNLOAD_URL, UV_INSTALLER_GITHUB_BASE_URL, UV_INSTALLER_GHE_BASE_URL, installer mirror, self update mirror, proxy repositories, releases.astral.sh, and installer source code. Followed astral-sh/uv#18525 comments and timeline to astral-sh/uv#19206 and inspected historical mirror reports astral-sh/uv#9134, astral-sh/uv#16519, and astral-sh/uv#17255. PR keyword searches returned no matches even for the known implementation; supplemented them with referenced PRs and the latest 200 PRs, so historical PR coverage is limited. Ruled out astral-sh/uv#22264 and astral-sh/uv#22373 as duplicates because they concern success-message URLs, and astral-sh/uv#22265 because it concerns NO_PROXY. Verified both published 0.12.23 installers, cargo-dist templates, and current self-update source.

type_reason: The unresolved installer follow-up in astral-sh/uv#18525 already describes the same ignored variable and need for a version-independent Astral mirror base URL. Duplicate classification takes precedence despite the source-confirmed omission. This is not an established regression: astral-sh/uv#19206 added support inside uv, while the identical standalone-installer gap was documented immediately afterward in 0.11.14 and remains present in 0.12.23.
summary: astral-sh/uv#18525 contains the exact unresolved installer discussion; astral-sh/uv#19206 implemented mirror support inside uv. astral-sh/uv#22264 concerns a separate logging defect.
draft_response:
The 0.12.23 standalone scripts do omit `UV_ASTRAL_MIRROR_URL`. The same gap and version-independent installation requirement are discussed in the May 18–19 comments on astral-sh/uv#18525. That issue was closed after astral-sh/uv#19206 added mirror support inside uv; direct installer support remained unimplemented. `uv self update` already passes a mirror-specific `UV_DOWNLOAD_URL` to the installer.

Please continue the installer discussion in astral-sh/uv#18525 so the remaining work stays together. For the source, these scripts are generated by cargo-dist: the templates are `installer.sh.j2` and `installer.ps1.j2` under https://github.com/axodotdev/cargo-dist/tree/main/cargo-dist/templates/installer.
